exercise1.prompt: A Datetime Index: The total in a month

hiddenCases.name: a month with nothing in it totals zero
the year is respected, not just the month

exercise1.hint: Set the day as the index and sort it, then select the month string. An empty selection sums to 0, which is the answer the first hidden case wants.

exercise2.prompt: A Datetime Index: The span the data covers

hiddenCases.name: the file order does not decide the answer
a year boundary is ordered by time

exercise2.hint: set_index("day").sort_index(), then the first and last index entries. strftime("%Y-%m-%d") turns each back into a plain string.

choices: Selecting a period with a string, and resampling
questions.explain: df.loc["2024-03"] is a whole month, and resample and rolling both read the index.

questions.prompt: df.loc["2024"] on a DatetimeIndex returns what?
questions.explain: Partial string indexing: the string names a period, not an instant.

choices: Slicing a time index expects it sorted
questions.explain: This is the one place where an unsorted index gives a wrong answer rather than an error.
